notes: Island polygons are place=island or place=islet features that have a name and a geometry.
nameEn is name:en, or the name tag when it is already in Latin script.
atoll is an official abbreviation from addr:atoll, is_in:atoll, or the admin_level 4 boundary that contains the island.
Harbour points are named harbour nodes, ferry terminals, and named piers.
A match is a geographic hint. It is not confirmation of a port call.

Seven admin_level 4 relations had no boundary geometry in the Overpass response: North Maalhosmadulu (R), South Maalhosmadulu (B), Mulaku (M), North Nilandhe (F), Kolhumadulu (Th), Hadhdhunmathi (L), and Fuvahmulah (Gn). Islands there keep a null atoll.
